decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several backpack types: tactical (prod_backpacks_057, prod_backpacks_107), sports-specific (prod_backpacks_122), hydration-focused (prod_backpacks_069), and ultra-lightweight packable (prod_backpacks_156). I chose the QT&QY 45L Military Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) as my final selection because it is a 'Best Seller' with a high 4.7 rating across over 6,000 reviews. At $39.99, it offers significant volume (45L) and durability for the price compared to the Seibertron Falcon (prod_backpacks_107), which is smaller and more expensive at $59.99. The review feedback regarding its build quality and compartment organization makes it a very compelling purchase for general outdoor and travel use.
